sources: Department of Personnel and Training (DoPT), Govt of India Gazetted Holiday List
Reserve Bank of India (RBI) Negotiable Instruments Act (NI Act) Section 25 List
State Government Official Gazettes (Karnataka, Maharashtra, Delhi, West Bengal, Tamil Nadu, Telangana)

national_holidays.name: Republic Day
national_holidays.description: National Holiday celebrating the Constitution of India. Falls on Monday offering a direct 3-day weekend (Sat 24 - Mon 26 Jan).

national_holidays.name: Maha Shivratri
national_holidays.description: Major festival honoring Lord Shiva. Falls on Monday creating a direct 3-day weekend (Sat 14 - Mon 16 Feb).

national_holidays.name: Holi
national_holidays.description: Festival of Colors. Falls on Wednesday. Taking Thursday (Mar 5) and Friday (Mar 6) off yields a continuous 5-day holiday.

national_holidays.name: Id-ul-Fitr (Ramadan Eid)
national_holidays.description: Culmination of holy month of Ramadan. Falls on Saturday.

national_holidays.name: Mahavir Jayanti
national_holidays.description: Birth anniversary of Lord Mahavira. Falls on Tuesday. Taking Monday (Mar 30) off yields a 4-day weekend.

national_holidays.name: Good Friday
national_holidays.description: Christian holy day commemorating the crucifixion. Falls on Friday creating a direct 3-day weekend (Fri 3 - Sun 5 Apr).

national_holidays.name: Buddha Purnima / May Day
national_holidays.description: Commemorates the birth of Lord Buddha / International Labour Day. Falls on Friday creating a direct 3-day weekend (Fri 1 - Sun 3 May).

national_holidays.name: Id-ul-Zuha (Bakrid)
national_holidays.description: Feast of the Sacrifice. Falls on Wednesday.

national_holidays.name: Muharram
national_holidays.description: First month of the Islamic calendar. Falls on Friday offering a direct 3-day weekend (Fri 26 - Sun 28 Jun).

national_holidays.name: Independence Day
national_holidays.description: National Holiday celebrating Indian independence. Falls on Saturday.

national_holidays.name: Milad-un-Nabi (Id-e-Milad)
national_holidays.description: Observance of the birthday of Islamic Prophet Muhammad. Falls on Wednesday.

national_holidays.name: Raksha Bandhan
national_holidays.description: Festival celebrating sibling bond. Falls on Friday creating a direct 3-day weekend (Fri 28 - Sun 30 Aug).

national_holidays.name: Janmashtami (Vaishnava)
national_holidays.description: Birth anniversary of Lord Krishna. Falls on Friday providing a direct 3-day weekend (Fri 4 - Sun 6 Sep).

national_holidays.name: Mahatma Gandhi's Birthday
national_holidays.description: National Holiday honoring Mahatma Gandhi. Falls on Friday providing a direct 3-day weekend (Fri 2 - Sun 4 Oct).

national_holidays.name: Dussehra (Vijayadashami)
national_holidays.description: Victory of good over evil. Falls on Tuesday. Taking Monday (Oct 19) off gives a 4-day weekend.

national_holidays.name: Diwali (Laxmi Pujan)
national_holidays.description: Festival of Lights. Falls on Sunday.

national_holidays.name: Govardhan Puja / Balipratipada
national_holidays.description: Day following Diwali. Falls on Monday extending Diwali celebrations into a 3-day weekend (Sat 7 - Mon 9 Nov).

national_holidays.name: Bhai Dooj
national_holidays.description: Celebration of sibling bond. Combined with Monday's Govardhan Puja, creates an automatic 4-day extended holiday (Sat 7 - Tue 10 Nov).

national_holidays.name: Guru Nanak Jayanti
national_holidays.description: Birth anniversary of Guru Nanak Dev Ji. Falls on Tuesday. Taking Monday (Nov 23) gives a 4-day weekend.

national_holidays.name: Christmas Day
national_holidays.description: Christmas celebration. Falls on Friday providing a direct 3-day weekend (Fri 25 - Sun 27 Dec).

national_holidays.name: New Year's Day
national_holidays.description: First day of the Gregorian year 2027. Falls on Friday providing a direct 3-day weekend (Fri 1 - Sun 3 Jan 2027) and enabling the 10-day Christmas to New Year vacation.

KA.name: Makar Sankranti
KA.description: Harvest festival in Karnataka. Taking Friday (Jan 16) gives a 4-day weekend.

KA.name: Ugadi (Kannada New Year)
KA.description: New Year celebration in Karnataka. Falls on Friday offering a direct 3-day weekend (Fri 20 - Sun 22 Mar).

KA.name: Dr. B.R. Ambedkar Jayanti
KA.description: Birth anniversary of Dr. Ambedkar. Taking Monday (Apr 13) yields a 4-day weekend.

KA.name: Ganesh Chaturthi
KA.description: Arrival of Lord Ganesha. Falls on Monday offering a direct 3-day weekend (Sat 12 - Mon 14 Sep).

KA.name: Maha Navami / Ayudha Puja
KA.description: Combined with Tuesday Dussehra (Oct 20), creates a 4-day weekend (Sat 17 - Tue 20 Oct) without taking any leaves!

KA.name: Kannada Rajyotsava
KA.description: Karnataka State Formation Day. Falls on Sunday.

KA.name: Kanakadasa Jayanti
KA.description: Birth anniversary of saint Kanakadasa. Falls on Friday offering a direct 3-day weekend (Fri 27 - Sun 29 Nov).

MH.name: Chhatrapati Shivaji Maharaj Jayanti
MH.description: Birth anniversary of Shivaji Maharaj. Taking Friday (Feb 20) yields a 4-day weekend.

MH.name: Gudi Padwa (Marathi New Year)
MH.description: Traditional Marathi New Year. Falls on Friday providing a direct 3-day weekend (Fri 20 - Sun 22 Mar).

MH.name: Maharashtra Day
MH.description: State formation day. Falls on Friday offering a direct 3-day weekend (Fri 1 - Sun 3 May).

MH.name: Ganesh Chaturthi
MH.description: Grand Ganesh festival. Falls on Monday offering a direct 3-day weekend (Sat 12 - Mon 14 Sep).

DL.name: Guru Gobind Singh Jayanti
DL.description: Birth anniversary of 10th Sikh Guru. Falls on Monday (Sat 3 - Mon 5 Jan).

DL.name: Raksha Bandhan
DL.description: Festival of brother-sister bond. Falls on Friday giving a direct 3-day weekend (Fri 28 - Sun 30 Aug).

DL.name: Chhath Puja
DL.description: Ancient Hindu Vedic festival dedicated to Sun God. Falls on Sunday.

WB.name: Netaji Subhas Chandra Bose Jayanti
WB.description: Birth anniversary of Netaji. Falls on Friday providing a direct 3-day weekend (Fri 23 - Sun 25 Jan).

WB.name: Poila Boishakh (Bengali New Year)
WB.description: First day of the Bengali calendar.

WB.name: Durga Puja (Maha Saptami to Vijaya Dashami)
WB.description: West Bengal's biggest festival. Taking Thu 22 & Fri 23 off yields a massive 9-day vacation!

TN.name: Pongal / Thiruvalluvar Day / Uzhavar Thirunal
TN.description: Harvest festival in Tamil Nadu. 3 days continuous off (Wed 14 - Fri 16) + Weekend = 5 Days Continuous Holiday without taking any leaves!

TN.name: Tamil New Year (Puthandu)
TN.description: First day of traditional Tamil calendar. Taking Mon 13 off yields a 4-day weekend.
